name: algorithm-engineer-full-cycle-test
title: 算法工程师全流程-test
description: 从业务目标、数据治理、候选算法、GPU benchmark、正式训练、业务评估到上线评审和实验台账的一站式算法迭代入口。
prompt_examples: 帮我训练一个YOLO抽烟检测模型

composite_skills.name: smoking_detection_agent_loop
composite_skills.description: Agent-loop implementation of the smoking detection training flow. The model should autonomously call the selected skills in order and pass artifacts forward instead of relying on a named workflow.
handoff_rules: After the user uploads a dataset archive and a reference image, do not start tools until prompt, labels, and training hyperparameters are explicitly provided.
Use image-dataset-generation with the uploaded reference image and the explicit prompt. Save generated images into the current thread output/workspace area.
Use data-auto-annotation on a merged image set that includes uploaded dataset images and generated images. Pass the explicit labels exactly.
Use gpu-training-orchestrator only after a real COCO JSON exists. Pass the COCO JSON path, merged dataset root, labels, and training hyperparameters.
Final answer is model-authored: summarize dataset merge counts, labels, split, best.pt, results.csv/results.png, and metrics such as precision, recall, mAP50, mAP50-95 when available.
done_when: best.pt exists in the current thread artifacts
results.csv exists in the current thread artifacts
annotations.coco.json exists in the current thread artifacts
